verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Jira exposes REST APIs and an official Atlassian MCP server that AI agents could use to script operations across many issues, but there is no explicit documentation of a bulk-edit/bulk-transition feature or confirmation it works well for AI-driven bulk actions; one community comment even notes Jira's UI historically lacked easy multi-select compared to competitors. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-operations API/UI documentation, evidence of scale/performance for bulk actions, and confirmation the MCP server supports batch operations rather than single-item calls.
